hysteria--noun.def: Wild uncontrolled emotion spreading through a person or crowd.
hysteria--noun.ex: Media hysteria followed the first case.
hysteria--noun.exTr: İlk vakanın ardından medyada histeri başladı.

slab--noun.def: A thick flat piece of stone, concrete or food.

stabilize--verb.def: To make something steady or stop it from changing further.

exorcism--noun.def: A religious ceremony to drive out an evil spirit.
exorcism--noun.ex: The film opens with an exorcism.
exorcism--noun.exTr: Film bir şeytan çıkarma sahnesiyle açılıyor.

hermit--noun.def: Someone who lives alone and avoids other people.
hermit--noun.ex: He lives like a hermit in the hills.

graft--noun.def: A piece of skin, bone or plant joined onto another.

banish--verb.def: To send someone away from a place as a punishment.

reconcile--verb.def: To make people friendly again, or to make two ideas fit together.
reconcile--verb.ex: He could not reconcile the two accounts.

commodity--noun.def: A raw material or product that is bought and sold.

hoist--verb.def: To lift something heavy using ropes or machinery.
hoist--verb.ex: They hoisted the flag at dawn.

uncanny--adj.def: Strange in a way that is hard to explain.
uncanny--adj.ex: She has an uncanny memory for faces.
uncanny--adj.exTr: Yüzler için tuhaf derecede iyi bir hafızası var.

nostalgia--noun.def: A fond longing for a happier time in the past.
nostalgia--noun.ex: Old songs fill him with nostalgia.

huddle--verb.def: To gather close together, usually for warmth or safety.
huddle--verb.ex: The sheep huddled against the wall.

huddle--noun.def: A small tight group of people or animals.

provocation--noun.def: An action meant to make someone angry or to cause a reaction.

perverse--adj.def: Deliberately behaving in a way most people find unreasonable.
perverse--adj.ex: She takes perverse pleasure in arguing.

paramount--adj.ex: Safety is paramount on this site.
paramount--adj.exTr: Bu şantiyede güvenlik her şeyden önemli.

malice--noun.def: The wish to harm or upset another person.

armory--noun.def: A place where weapons are stored.
armory--noun.ex: Guards locked the armory at night.

choreography--noun.def: The art of arranging the steps of a dance.

reproach--verb.def: To tell someone you are disappointed in what they did.

palate--noun.def: The roof of the mouth, or a person's taste in food.
palate--noun.ex: The wine suits a delicate palate.

curator--noun.def: The person in charge of the collection in a museum.
curator--noun.ex: The curator arranged the new wing.

reconciliation--noun.def: The return to friendly relations after a quarrel.

induce--verb.def: To persuade someone to act, or to cause something to happen.
induce--verb.ex: Nothing could induce her to sign.
induce--verb.exTr: Hiçbir şey onu imzalamaya ikna edemedi.

nostalgic--adj.def: Feeling or causing a fond longing for the past.

apprehend--verb.def: To catch and arrest someone suspected of a crime.
apprehend--verb.ex: Officers apprehended him at the border.

collide--verb.def: To hit something else while moving, often with force.
collide--verb.ex: Two trains collided in the fog.

cinematography--noun.def: The art of filming and lighting scenes for a film.

unravel--verb.def: To come apart thread by thread, or to explain something confusing.

blitz--verb.def: To attack a target suddenly and with full force.
blitz--verb.ex: Advertisers blitzed the city with posters.

blitz--noun.def: A sudden concentrated attack or effort.

meticulous--adj.def: Giving very careful attention to every small detail.

whirlwind--noun.def: A column of spinning wind, or a rush of hectic events.

depraved--adj.def: Morally corrupt and capable of cruel acts.
depraved--adj.ex: The court called the crime depraved.

cognitive--adj.def: Relating to thinking, learning and understanding.

denounce--verb.def: To criticize someone publicly, or to report them to authorities.

maverick--noun.def: Someone who thinks and acts independently of the group.
maverick--noun.ex: He was a maverick among economists.

contraption--noun.def: A machine that looks strange or unnecessarily complicated.
contraption--noun.ex: The kitchen was full of contraptions.

infernal--adj.def: Belonging to hell, or annoying beyond endurance.

cordon--verb.def: To surround an area with guards or barriers so nobody enters.

cocoon--verb.def: To wrap or protect something completely.
cocoon--verb.ex: Fame cocooned her from ordinary life.
cocoon--verb.exTr: Şöhret onu sıradan hayattan yalıtıp korudu.

wayward--adj.def: Difficult to control and behaving unpredictably.
wayward--adj.ex: His wayward son came home at last.

corpus--noun.def: A large collection of texts gathered for study.
corpus--noun.ex: The dictionary rests on a huge corpus.

pedestrian--adj.ex: The speech was competent but pedestrian.

rhetorical--adj.def: Relating to effective speaking, or asked without wanting an answer.

brood--verb.def: To keep thinking about something sad or worrying.

brood--noun.def: All the young birds or children of one family.

articulate--adj.def: Able to express thoughts clearly and fluently.
articulate--adj.ex: She is the most articulate speaker here.
articulate--adj.exTr: Buradaki en düzgün konuşan kişi o.

conduit--noun.def: A pipe carrying liquid, or a channel through which things pass.
conduit--noun.ex: The charity became a conduit for aid.
conduit--noun.exTr: Dernek yardım için bir kanal hâline geldi.

pedestal--noun.def: The base on which a statue or column stands.
pedestal--noun.ex: The bust sits on a marble pedestal.

eminent--adj.def: Famous and admired within a profession.
eminent--adj.ex: An eminent judge chaired the panel.
eminent--adj.exTr: Seçkin bir yargıç kurula başkanlık etti.

minefield--noun.def: Ground full of hidden mines, or a situation full of dangers.
minefield--noun.ex: Tax law is a legal minefield.
minefield--noun.exTr: Vergi hukuku hukuki bir mayın tarlası.

maggot--noun.def: The small worm-like young of a fly.

nigh--adv.def: Near in time or place, used in older or formal style.

residual--adj.def: Remaining after most of something has gone.

authenticity--noun.def: The quality of being genuine rather than copied.

beneficiary--noun.def: A person who receives money or advantage from something.
beneficiary--noun.ex: His niece is the sole beneficiary.

perch--verb.def: To sit on the edge of something high or narrow.
perch--verb.ex: A crow perched on the wire.

perch--noun.def: A branch or bar where a bird rests.

patronize--verb.def: To treat someone as if they were less intelligent than you.

misdemeanor--noun.def: A minor offence that is not a serious crime.
misdemeanor--noun.ex: He was fined for a misdemeanor.

condone--verb.def: To accept behaviour that others think is wrong.
condone--verb.ex: The school does not condone cheating.

scavenger--noun.def: An animal that feeds on dead matter, or a person collecting waste.

seismic--adj.def: Caused by earthquakes, or very large in effect.
seismic--adj.ex: The vote caused a seismic shift.
seismic--adj.exTr: Oylama sarsıcı bir değişime yol açtı.

prolong--verb.def: To make something last longer than it would.

anonymity--noun.def: The condition of having your name kept unknown.

hindsight--noun.def: Understanding of an event only after it has happened.
hindsight--noun.ex: In hindsight, the price was fair.

locomotive--noun.def: The engine that pulls a railway train.
locomotive--noun.ex: A steam locomotive led the train.

agile--adj.def: Able to move or think quickly and easily.

integration--noun.def: The process of combining parts or groups into one whole.
integration--noun.ex: Integration of the two systems took months.

secular--adj.def: Not connected with religion or religious institutions.

headmistress--noun.def: A woman who is the head of a school.

combustion--noun.def: The process of burning, especially of fuel.

indulgence--noun.def: Allowing yourself or others too much of a pleasure.

callous--adj.def: Showing no concern for the suffering of others.

annex--noun.def: A building added to and used with a larger one.

annex--verb.def: To take control of a territory and add it to your own.

rapture--noun.def: A feeling of extreme joy and delight.
